Track: Coordination

## C **EXPLICIT P #785 RELEASE** — Stage2B3a authentic completed-arm caller seal, SOURCE-ISSUER ONLY (2026-10-23 JST)

**RELEASE precisely this Issue's bounded Gate0→conditional existing-issuer snapshot completion→public proof validation work.** No new Draft17.34 semantics and no R-B native backend work approved. Run **P-EQUIVALENT WORK/CODEX production implementation environment**, isolated new P-only branch, one DRAFT/DO NOT MERGE PR and fixed candidate GitHub Actions. DO NOT use normal Chat-only for actual P code edits, do not work in R branch, do not self-merge/close. Starting authority freshly verified: Compiler/main **`77d83dfc00850b14fd7c3bc95e7e3c12e34161fb`**, canonical Draft17.34; exact main natural [FULL5 #39945752721](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/actions/runs/39945752721) 5×443 and [PARTIAL #39945752657](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/actions/runs/39945752657) 442, both complete PASS. No later main changes seen at release.

**Required first comment / Gate0 before edits:** genuine R-B source SHA `12c5c66c413a57fd78549cb4563c71c6831d0f151b53b2d4569d32f7b50a1af5`, original R #776 first-pass failure preserved, true A owner/body/graph membership, completed source/world/root/count, source-issued `nl_copy_body_seal` first `!caller_nodes` predicate and actual return/loan proof; use [M #783 first-predicate review](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/issues/783#issuecomment-6364093398), [C accepted design hypothesis](https://github.com/wakairo/NewLang_Compiler/issues/783#issuecomment-6364116563). Distinguish `body_status=3` vs CHECK0, private H/T backend CLI4, and owner-custody A already finite R780 PASS. Only if true arm-owned completion through existing issuer is sufficient can a narrow change proceed. New source right/independent receipt/wider design ⇒ STOP, ask C/M/F (§4.2). Do not merely force `caller_nodes` nonnull, spoof graph/world id, eliminate validation, or seal before graph is immutable.

**Acceptance:** source-issued **public T Copy body+parameter validator both `NL_CHECK_OK`** for original unchanged R-B call74 and a pre-frozen independently P-authored differently named/indexed legitimate arm source; entire currentness/replay/old Copy/sibling remains genuinely checked, wrong/root/alien-world/consumed/entry errors stay reject and snapshot issuer OOM rollback+retry really exercised; old R-A and p713/p718/p728 do not regress. **R-B `newlangc` ordinary and named C17 must STILL fail closed (CLI4, zero generated stdout, unchanged named sentinel)**, because B3b emitter support not authorized. No H owner ABI or C17 change. All 443/442 previous CTests retained, K≥4 new distinct names and one stable natural FULL5/PARTIAL pair expected 443+K/442+K. On first next validator precision3 or substantive test failure STOP with exact predicate, no expanding into B3b. P may report hold.

**Independence and next gate:** any new trusted issuer warrants separately **fresh FIRST-PASS BLIND R (normal Chat+dedicated R branch+GitHub Actions, NOT P-equivalent environment)** after P candidate/source independent oracle freeze; NO automatic R launch or P merge. R #776 original initial COVERAGE FAIL cannot be relabeled; R #780 finite NON-BLIND calibrated A-only PASS remains. Separate B #784 research plan/Work scratch runs on pinned main and does not alter/source-check this P lane. Product GO #624 PAUSED, cJSON H1 #268 HOLD; author+ordinary-safe caller audit-locality vs well-factored C still not proven.

**§4.3 Goal/Evidence/Alternatives/STOP:** TRUE issuer precision and v0 source combinability; evidence frozen R-B CHECK0/public3/backend refusal and M causal analysis; alternative maintain conservative fail-closed or adopt a new receipt only after §4.2/M/F review. STOP unsafe attachment, wrong world, partial publication, dirty OOM, new semantics/foreign/LLVM/CFG scope, toolchain trust relaxation or unsupported follow-up validator. This RELEASE is limited P Stage2B3a, not R-B C17/native and not generalized backend-plan adoption.
